review_corrections.problem: Ordinary handoff document refresh bypassed cadence.
review_corrections.resolution: Only explicit git_boundary handoff/risk or complete flush early; normal handoff updated is not a Git boundary.

review_corrections.problem: Pending paths could cross workflows and grant ownership of old dirty files.
review_corrections.resolution: Bind pending_workflow_id; begin refuses replacing a pending workflow baseline.

review_corrections.problem: Deferred exact event retry could use new unvalidated bytes.
review_corrections.resolution: Persist original source/scope fingerprint; require new verified stage when bytes change.

review_corrections.problem: HEAD could advance between precheck and native commit, publishing wrong parent/tree.
review_corrections.resolution: Run native hooks/signing commit in private detached context, verify tree/parent/token, persist prepared oid then compare-and-swap exact real branch.

review_corrections.problem: Changing scope while paths awaited publication could falsely cover omitted paths.
review_corrections.resolution: Public configuration rejects allow/status scope changes while pending/deferred; explicit disable retires scheduling and lists uncommitted paths without changing files.

review_corrections.problem: Reverted deferred paths leaked queue slots; noop events lacked receipts and could later reuse old validation.
review_corrections.resolution: Retire only current workflow deferrals when all selected differences vanish; record unchanged receipt for every successful noop, with fixed256 cache covering current200-stage contract.
